metadata.title: Topological obstruction for Anosov representations into $\operatorname{PO}(p, q)$
metadata.abstract: We establish new restrictions on the virtual cohomological dimension of word hyperbolic groups admitting Anosov representations into $\operatorname{PO}(p, q)$ ($p > q \geq 2$) or the exceptional Lie group $\operatorname{G}_2'$. Our main result states that, if $P_k$ is the parabolic subgroup of $\operatorname{PO}(p, q)$ stabilizing an isotropic $k$-plane in $\mathbb{R}^{p, q}$, a group admitting a $\{P_1,P_q\}$-Anosov representation into $\operatorname{PO}(p, q)$ has virtual cohomological dimension strictly less than $p$. As a result, a $\mathbf{H}^{p, q-1}$-convex cocompact subgroup of $\operatorname{PO}(p, q)$ cannot act properly discontinuously and cocompactly on $\mathbf{H}^{p, q-1}$. The main theorem also implies that a group admitting a $P_{\alpha}$-Anosov representation into the exceptional Lie group $\operatorname{G}_2'$ has virtual cohomological dimension strictly less than $4$, where $\alpha$ is a short restricted root of $\operatorname{G}_2'$. As an application, we prove that the homogeneous space $\operatorname{G}_2'/ \operatorname{SU}(2, 1)$ does not admit any compact quotient.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明若双曲群具有 PO(p,q) 中所述 {P1,Pq}-Anosov 表示，则虚上同调维数严格小于 p；推出相应伪双曲凸余紧群不能同时在伪双曲空间上余紧作用，并得到分裂 G2 的维数小于四及 G2′/SU(2,1) 无紧商结论。
analysis.breakthrough: 以群的拓扑维数排除特定高秩表示和 Clifford–Klein 紧商。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。需要指定抛物型及 p>q≥2；结论不是所有 Anosov 表示或所有 G2 齐性空间的普遍障碍。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: Declaration of AI use 明确披露 ChatGPT 与 Gemini 辅助澄清背景、证明探索和语言润色，ChatGPT-5.6 还辅助检索 SU(2,1) 例子的文献。作者说明模型对推论 1.5 给出的证明错误，但交流提供启发并帮助其组织证明、推广至引理 1.4；核心策略和关键论证由作者实质性发展并核验。保留错误建议和人工主导的限定，不将其计为 AI 提供核心想法。
